answer_1.quote: Our aim is to generate a summary y of the opinions expressed in X.

answer_2.quote: Following previous work we report five metrics: METEOR, a recall-oriented metric that rewards matching stems, synonyms, and paraphrases; ROUGE-SU4, the recall of unigrams and skip-bigrams of up to four words; and the F1-score of ROUGE-1/2/L, which respectively measures word-overlap, bigram-overlap, and the longest common subsequence between system and reference summaries.

answer_4.quote: We also conducted two judgment elicitation studies using the Amazon Mechanical Turk (AMT) crowdsourcing platform.
answer_4.guideline: Study 1: Participants selected best/worst summaries based on Informativeness, Coherence, Grammaticality. Study 2: Participants verified level of support (fully, partially, not at all) for summary sentences relative to input reviews.
